criteria.statement: No command or contract prose tells an agent to `git add` or `git commit` a run-records path: `grep -nE 'git (add|commit).*(\.trd-state|<state-dir>|<work\.stateDir>)' packages/core/commands/*.md packages/core/contracts/*.md` finds nothing
criteria.cites: After 1, l.58-59; Before l.5-23 (the explicit records commits it removes)
criteria.evidence: Terminal transcript of that exact grep, showing the command line and exit status 1 with no matched lines

criteria.statement: `/plan` §7a.5's commit list (the sweep chain's commit) names no `.trd-state/` path
criteria.cites: After 1, l.59; Before l.19 (`plan.md:1186-1195` committed `.trd-state/<slug>-sweep/`)
criteria.evidence: Excerpt of `packages/core/commands/plan.md` §7a.5 with line numbers, plus `grep -n '\.trd-state' ` over that section's line range returning nothing

criteria.statement: Each of the 11 named files names `record-ref.js write`: the commands `implement-trd`, `audit-build`, `close-feature`, `ship-build`, `verify-build`, `plan`, `amend`, `refine-verification`, `task`, `sweep`, and `contracts/ship-primitive-push.md`
criteria.cites: After 1, l.59-61
criteria.evidence: `grep -c 'record-ref.js write'` over each of the 11 files under `packages/core/`, transcript showing a count of at least 1 for every file

criteria.statement: A Jest prose test pins both FS-1 (no records `git add`/`git commit` in command or contract prose) and FS-3 (each named file names `record-ref.js write`), and it passes
criteria.cites: After 1, l.61 ("a Jest prose test pins both")
criteria.evidence: `npx jest <that test file>` output showing the test names for both assertions and a passing result

criteria.statement: In a repo scaffolded by `scaffold-project.sh`, `git check-ignore --no-index` reports each of these 5 paths as ignored: `.trd-state/<f>/implement.json`, `.trd-state/<f>/closed.json`, `.trd-state/<f>/artifacts.json`, `.trd-state/_session-log.md`, `.trd-state/_sweep/discovered.jsonl`
criteria.cites: After 2, l.62-64; Before l.26-27 (the ignore file today ignores only scratch)
criteria.evidence: Transcript in a freshly scaffolded scratch repo: `git check-ignore --no-index -v` on the 5 paths, each printed with the `.gitignore` line that matches it

criteria.statement: In the same scaffolded repo, `git check-ignore --no-index` does NOT report any of these 3 paths: `.trd-state/_docs-audit/last-run.json`, `.claude/verification-notes.md`, `OWNER-CALLS.md`
criteria.cites: After 2, l.64-65
criteria.evidence: Same transcript: `git check-ignore --no-index` on each of the 3 paths, each run shown with exit status 1 and no output

criteria.statement: Scaffold and `--git-files` leave every already-tracked record tracked — including the shared log `.trd-state/_session-log.md` — while the scratch ignore lines still untrack scratch files as they do today
criteria.cites: After 2, l.66-67; Before l.28-32 (`ensure_gitignore untrack` would untrack `_session-log.md`, the sibling-branch conflict)
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo with tracked `.trd-state/<f>/implement.json`, `.trd-state/_session-log.md` and a tracked scratch file (e.g. `.trd-state/<f>/dispatch.jsonl`); after running scaffold and then `--git-files`, `git ls-files .trd-state` transcript shows the two records still listed and the scratch file gone

criteria.statement: After scaffolding, `.claude/settings.json` has `ensemble.records == "ref"`, and an owner who set a different value keeps it across `--refresh`
criteria.cites: After 2, l.68-69; Before l.45-46 (no `records` key backfilled today)
criteria.evidence: Transcript: `jq '.ensemble.records' .claude/settings.json` printing `"ref"` after scaffold; then the value edited to another string, `--refresh` run, and `jq` printing the edited value

criteria.statement: `/implement-trd` Step 5 runs `git add -A; git commit` first, then records the checkpoint with that commit's id, then calls `record-ref.js write` — in that order
criteria.cites: After 3, l.70-71; Before l.5-9 (checkpoint recorded before the commit, so it named the previous commit)
criteria.evidence: Excerpt of `packages/core/commands/implement-trd.md` Step 5 with line numbers showing `git add -A`/`git commit`, the checkpoint recording, and `record-ref.js write` on ascending lines

criteria.statement: In a fixture run that implements a small change, the checkpoint recorded in `implement.json` names the code commit that the phase checkpoint made
criteria.cites: After 3, l.71-72
criteria.evidence: From a `fixtures` slot after the run: `git log --format='%H %s' <feature-branch>` and the checkpoint's `commit` field (read from the records ref or worktree `implement.json`), the same hash appearing in both

criteria.statement: In a fixture run that implements a small change (for example `/plan --implement`), the feature branch gains no commit that touches only `.trd-state/`, and the finished run's `implement.json` is on the feature's records ref
criteria.cites: After 3, l.71-72 ("the branch has no records-only commit"; `record-ref.js write` runs after the checkpoint); Before l.20-23 (110 of 300 `main` commits were records-only)
criteria.evidence: From the `fixtures` slot: for each commit on the branch since its base, `git show --name-only --format=%H <c>` showing at least one path outside `.trd-state/`; then `git cat-file -p refs/ensemble/records/<slug>:implement.json` showing the task list with tasks complete

criteria.statement: On the default branch, a `record-ref.js write` whose push fails returns `outcome: "ref"` with `push: "failed"` (the ref was written locally), creates no branch commit and untracks nothing; `git log main` is unchanged
criteria.cites: After 4, l.73-76; Before l.47-50 (`[ran]` the same write today returned `outcome: "fallback"` and added a commit to `main`)
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo on `main` with an unreachable `origin`: `git rev-parse main` before and after, the write's JSON output, `git show-ref refs/ensemble/records/<slug>`, and `git status --porcelain` showing no staged deletions

criteria.statement: On the default branch, a `record-ref.js write` that cannot write the ref returns `outcome: "failed"` with `fallbackSkipped: "default-branch"`, makes no branch commit, and leaves the records in the worktree
criteria.cites: After 4, l.75-76
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo on `main` where the ref write is made to fail: the write's JSON output, `git rev-parse main` unchanged before and after, and `ls .trd-state/<slug>/` showing the record files still present

criteria.statement: On the default branch, a write aimed at a ref whose tip names a different feature does not touch it: `outcome: "refused"`, reason `identity`, and the ref still holds its earlier files
criteria.cites: After 4, l.77-78; Before l.40-42 (a `/close-feature` on `main` would replace a feature's ref with one holding only `closed.json` under `main`)
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo: seed `refs/ensemble/records/<slug>` from a feature branch, switch to `main`, run the write; transcript of its JSON output and `git rev-parse refs/ensemble/records/<slug>` identical before and after

criteria.statement: On a detached HEAD, `record-ref.js write` behaves as on the default branch: no branch commit, nothing untracked
criteria.cites: After 4, l.73 ("or a detached HEAD")
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo with `git checkout --detach`: write's JSON output, `git rev-parse HEAD` unchanged, `git status --porcelain` showing no staged deletions

criteria.statement: With `--no-fallback`, a write on a feature branch that cannot reach the ref makes no branch commit
criteria.cites: After 4, l.78 ("With `--no-fallback` (any branch) the same no-commit rule applies")
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo on a feature branch, ref write made to fail, `--no-fallback` passed: write's JSON output and `git rev-parse HEAD` unchanged before and after

criteria.statement: A `--shared` write never untracks anything: the shared log `.trd-state/_session-log.md` stays tracked after it
criteria.cites: After 4, l.78-79; Before l.36-38 (the fold also ran for `--shared` writes)
criteria.evidence: Scratch feature branch with `_session-log.md` tracked: `--shared` write, then `git ls-files .trd-state/_session-log.md` still listing it and `git status --porcelain` showing no staged deletion

criteria.statement: On a feature branch, a write that moves branch-tracked records onto the ref commits their removal by pathspec with the message `records(<slug>): moved to refs/ensemble/records/<slug>`, after which merging the base branch in (`merge-base-in`) succeeds
criteria.cites: After 4, l.79-81; Before l.34-39 (the removal was left staged and made `git merge --no-ff --no-commit <base>` refuse)
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo: feature branch with tracked `.trd-state/<slug>/implement.json`, run the write, then `git log -1 --format=%s --name-status` showing the message and the deletions, `git status --porcelain` clean, then the merge-base-in step (or `git merge --no-ff --no-commit <base>`) exiting 0

criteria.statement: On a feature branch, when the ref cannot be written or pushed and `--no-fallback` is not given, the write still falls back to a branch commit exactly as before
criteria.cites: After 4, l.81 ("otherwise the fallback is exactly as before"); Before l.47-48
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo on a feature branch with an unreachable `origin`: write's JSON output showing `"outcome":"fallback"` and `git log -1 --format=%s` showing a new `records(<slug>): …` commit

criteria.statement: With no feature active, `precompact.js` appends to `.trd-state/_session-log.md` and then writes `refs/ensemble/records/_shared` locally, without pushing or touching the network
criteria.cites: After 5, l.82; Before l.24-25 (nothing carried the shared log anywhere but a later `git add -A`)
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo with no active feature and no reachable remote: run the hook, then `git cat-file -p refs/ensemble/records/_shared:_session-log.md` showing the newly appended entry, and the hook's output or a trace showing no push attempted

criteria.statement: `/sweep` writes the shared records ref at its end
criteria.cites: After 5, l.83; Before l.24 (`/sweep` never committed)
criteria.evidence: Excerpt of `packages/core/commands/sweep.md` with line numbers showing a `record-ref.js write` with `--shared` in its final step

criteria.statement: When the records ref holds post-merge `shipped.json` and `custody.json` and the worktree's `.trd-state/<slug>/` holds older, pre-merge copies of both, a `record-ref.js write` leaves the ref holding the post-merge copies of both files while it updates the folder's other records on the ref as usual; when the worktree's copies are the further-along ones, they are written as before
criteria.cites: After 6, l.84-89 (amendment, product PM, 2026-11-12)
criteria.evidence: Scratch repo on a feature branch: seed `refs/ensemble/records/<slug>` with post-merge `shipped.json`/`custody.json` (recording the merge), leave pre-merge copies of both in the worktree and change `implement.json`; run the write; transcript of `git rev-parse refs/ensemble/records/<slug>:shipped.json` and `:custody.json` identical before and after, `git cat-file -p refs/ensemble/records/<slug>:implement.json` showing the change; then a second run with the worktree copies further along, `git cat-file -p` showing the worktree content on the ref
